main.description: List recent inbound emails received by the mailer. Backed by ai.gftd.apps.mailer.inboundEmail records on did:web:ml1nb0nd.gftd.ai (the inbound mailer DID where the email-relay Worker writes parsed inbound mail). Catch-all routing in Cloudflare Email Routing means *@gftd.ai is always received; this command exposes the mail.

toLocal.description: Optional local-part filter (e.g. "uspto-acct" returns only mail addressed to uspto-acct@gftd.ai).

uri.description: AT URI of the inboundEmail record.

toLocal.description: Local part (before @gftd.ai). Plaintext only when content is unencrypted; otherwise the literal "[encrypted]".

toLocalHash.description: SHA-256 hex of the local part (always present, addressable even when ciphertext is sealed).

subject.description: Plaintext when content is unencrypted; otherwise the literal "[encrypted]".

bodyText.description: Plaintext when content is unencrypted; otherwise the literal "[encrypted]".

error.description: Set on PDS fetch failure; items will be empty.
